meta_description:
296 likes, 49 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 23, 2026: "Comment LIGHT aur main DM mein 3 sabse sasti trusted dukaanon ki location aur shop numbers bhej dunga 🪔

Ye hai Bhagirath Palace, Chandni Chowk, Lajpat Rai Market ke bilkul saath. Asia ki sabse badi electrical market, 1000 se zyada dukaanein.

Diwali lights aur jhalar yahan ₹15 se shuru hoti hai, aur jo jhoomar bahar ₹10,000 ka milta hai wo yahan ₹2,000 mein mil jaata hai. LED lights, wires, switches, Havells, Anchor, Polycab, sab wholesale rate pe.

Delhi mein sasta jhoomar market ya Diwali decoration ka wholesale market dhoondh rahe ho toh yahi jagah hai.

Timing: 11:30 AM se 6:30 PM. Sunday band rehta hai.

Ek hi cheez ke 10 alag rate milenge, toh bina bargain kiye kuch mat lena.

#bhagirathpalace #chandnichowk #diwalilights #wholesalemarket #delhitravelblogger".
